title: SQL AG acl: shared instance logins via the primary
description: The nexus-cli acl verb for the Always On AG: list server principals via the AG primary (the AG shares the instance security surface).

observe.what: the same server-principal surface as the FCI (the AG primary IS the FCI); grant/revoke manage fixed-server-role membership

whatProves: acl on the AG plane reads the instance logins/roles via the primary; the AG and FCI share one security surface.
